fields.meta_title: Podcast Application Form Builder for Guests | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Build a podcast application form that collects guest pitches, links to past interviews, and recording setup, then sends each pitch to your host.
fields.h1: Build a Podcast Application Form for Guests and Co-Hosts
fields.hero_description: Build a podcast application form that keeps each guest's pitch and audio sample in a database you own.
fields.features_heading: What a Host Needs Before Saying Yes to a Guest
fields.features_subheading: A podcast application form built in Emergent asks up front what you would otherwise chase over email before booking a recording.
fields.feature_1:
A topic pitch with a word limit

Ask for the episode topic in 150 words or fewer, plus three questions the guest would like to hear. The host reads the pitch and the questions together on one review screen.
fields.feature_2:
Past interviews and audio clips on file

Let guests link episodes they have appeared on, or upload a short audio clip if they have none. The links and files stay on the application, so nobody digs through an inbox.
fields.feature_3:
Setup questions that change the next step

Ask which microphone the guest records on and whether they wear headphones. Picking a laptop mic can send your producer a note to mail a loaner before the recording date.
fields.feature_4:
Pitches sent to the person who books

Route guest pitches to the host in Slack and co-host auditions to the producer by email. Name a backup reviewer for the weeks when the host is away at a trade conference.
fields.feature_5:
A recording release signed in the form

Close with your release terms in plain words and a typed or drawn signature. The signature and the date it was signed are saved with the application, in a database you own.
fields.feature_6:
Code a developer can keep building

On paid plans, export the code for the form and its review screens to your GitHub repository. A developer can host it on your own servers or keep extending it from there.
fields.why_title: Why Build Podcast Applications With Emergent?
fields.why_description: Pitches sent by email split the links and the release across threads. An application holds both on one record you can book from.

fields.usecase_heading: How Four Shows Act on an Application
fields.tab_content_1:
Henrike reads every pitch with past interviews in Slack

Workbench Hours books one woodworking guest for each weekly episode. Anand Kandasamy pitches an episode on hand-cut dovetails and links 2 past interviews. Every pitch with past interviews goes to Henrike Osterlund, the host, in Slack, and she reads his the day he applies.
fields.tab_content_2:
Any guest on a laptop mic gets a loaner

The Long Haul Hour records truck drivers remotely, so its form asks what each guest will speak into. Cormac Ellery answers Laptop mic. Any guest on a laptop mic sets off an email to Matteo Quiroga, the producer, to ship a loaner before the March 18 recording.
fields.tab_content_3:
Samples rated 4 or higher get a callback

Old Ferry Road needs a co-host for its local history show, and every applicant uploads a 2-minute audio sample. Yewande Balogun, the producer, rates each one from 1 to 5. Sunniva Brekke's sample gets a 5, and every sample rated 4 or higher goes on the callback list.
fields.tab_content_4:
Ignatius books Philippa with her release on file

Pocket Garden Radio closes its guest form with a recording release: the episode's audio and video may be published and clipped for social posts. Philippa Okonjo signs it with a drawn signature. Ignatius Borrero, the host, books her with the signed release and its date on file.

plan.angle: Pages for a podcast application form stop at a template with name, email and topic. This page shows what a show does with each application after it arrives: a woodworking interview show that reads every pitch in Slack, a trucking show that ships a loaner mic to a guest on a laptop mic, a local history show that rates co-host audition samples, and a gardening show that books a guest only after the recording release is signed.
